note: After Emerson & Banks's description of the new species of 1965 (in English); the 2 alates (female holotype, male paratype) and 30 soldiers each have a measurement table, which is transcribed item by item without conversion. The worker is not described in the original.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: One of the smaller species of the genus, with a relatively short labrum and relatively many setae on the head. Fontanelle tube short, situated in the middle of the line between the antennal bases; the outer margin of the fore coxa with a blunt process near its base. Alate antennae 16-segmented; the sides of the pronotum slightly arcuate, the posterior margin shallowly concave. Compared with L. longilabius most measurements are slightly smaller and the sides of the head flatter; compared with L. pelliceus the pilosity of the head is far sparser, the curvature of the lateral margins of the labrum gentler, and the eyes smaller and farther from the ocelli.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head medium reddish brown, with pale areas in the middle and behind the eyes; antennae pale yellowish brown, slightly paler than the postclypeus; postclypeus pale brown, paler than the vertex; labrum concolorous with the postclypeus, with a broad transparent labral rim at the end; pronotum pale brown; wing scales partly dark brown, wing membrane pale yellow and transparent, the costa and radius as dark as the wing scales along most of the wing. Head and postclypeus with a few long setae, the anterior margin and sides of the labrum with several setae, the middle of the pronotum with scattered short hairs and setae, the anterior and lateral margins with more hairs. Head oval and slightly long; the median line between the eyes bulging outwards at the raised ocelli and sharply depressed in the middle; fontanelle indistinct, slit-like and depressed, about 4—5 times as long as wide. Eyes large and oval, their distance from the lower margin of the head 1/6—1/10 of their diameter; ocelli large, nearly elliptical, about as large as the antennal socket, their distance from the eye slightly more than half their width. Antennae 16-segmented, segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2, segment 4 equal to or slightly shorter than segment 3. Postclypeus longer than half its width. Pronotum about 9/10 of the head width, the sides slightly curved, the anterior and posterior margins shallowly concave, the median suture distinct; the posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum deeply concave, the median angle about 125°. Measurements (female holotype/male paratype, mm): head length (to the apex of the labrum) 1.76/1.68, head length (to the mandibular base) 1.27/1.06, head width 1.59/1.56, fontanelle length 0.12/0.15, width 0.02/0.03, distance from the fontanelle to the ocellus 0.49/0.43, eye diameter 0.47/0.49, distance from the lower margin of the eye 0.05/0.08, distance from the ocellus to the eye 0.10/0.09, ocellus length 0.22/0.21, width 0.17/0.15, postclypeus length 0.44, width 0.65, pronotum length 0.85/0.80, width 1.38/1.37, hind tibia 1.94/1.88, fore wing scale length 0.85/0.80, fore wing length from the suture 13.41/13.35, width 3.66/3.72.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow to pale reddish brown, the postmentum concolorous with the vertex but darker at the lateral margins; antennae yellow; postclypeus concolorous with the vertex, labrum concolorous with the vertex but darker at the sides and broadly white at the end; the outer half of the mandibles dark brown, nearly black, the base dark orange brown and darker than the vertex; the posterior part of the pronotum and the posterior part of the frontal lobe pale yellowish brown, the anterior part of the frontal lobe yellow; legs, abdominal tergites and sternites yellow. Head and labrum with many setae, the opening of the fontanelle tube with a ring of short hairs; the anterior half of the postmentum with a few setae and some micro-hairs; the anterior margin of the pronotum with many setae and short hairs, the posterior margin with only a few setae near the lateral corners, the frontal lobe and the middle of the base almost bare. Head nearly square, slightly narrower in front, the sides and posterior margin slightly convex, the posterior corners broadly rounded; fontanelle tube rather short, situated in the middle between the antennal bases. Postmentum about 2.4 times as long as its maximum width, the maximum width about 1.6 times the minimum width. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 5 shorter than segment 2 and longer than segment 3, segment 4 shortest or about as long as segment 3, in most specimens the boundary between segments 3 and 4 indistinct. Labrum rather short, the sides moderately convex, in some specimens retracted and appearing even shorter. Anterior lobe of the pronotum large, the anterior margin distinctly concave, the posterior margin straight or slightly concave but not notched; in lateral view the base and the anterior lobe almost in a straight line. Measurements (holotype/range of 30 paratypes/mean, mm): head length (to the apex of the mandibles) 3.32/2.81—3.40/3.08, head length (to the apex of the labrum) 2.79/2.59—3.03/2.80, head length (to the mandibular base) 2.20/1.98—2.50/2.24, head width 1.66/1.46—1.75/1.60, head thickness (including the fontanelle tube and postmentum) 1.41/1.25—1.42/1.36, fontanelle tube length 0.12/0.12—0.24/0.17, postmentum length 1.23/1.18—1.35/1.25, postmentum maximum width 0.53/0.46—0.54/0.52, postmentum minimum width 0.35/0.28—0.35/0.32, labrum length (from the lateral base) 0.47/0.43—0.68/0.51, labrum width 0.57/0.52—0.57/0.54, left mandible length 1.18/1.04—1.18/1.12, pronotum length 0.59/0.52—0.66/0.59, width 1.02/0.80—1.06/0.98, hind tibia 1.47/1.30—1.56/1.43.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The type locality is Novo Horizonte, São Paulo, Brazil; the paratype locality is Corumbá, Mato Grosso, Brazil; the specimens were collected by R. L. Araujo between 1945 and 1952. The original does not describe the worker.
